Items.Name: wallet
Items.Description: Your id is placed crooked in the clear pocket. Five dollars and some change are crumpled next to your Chase Bank Visa Credit Card, unsigned.
Items.InitialDescription: Your wallet sits idle in the center console.

Items.Name: phone
Items.Description: It is so dead, you dont even get phantom buzzes.
Items.InitialDescription: Next to your wallet sits your phone, the low charge light flashing as you press the lock button.

Items.Name: blanket
Items.InitialDescription: In your trunk you remember putting a few things back there, one of which is a large dark green blanket. It has a couple holes in it, but it still serves its purpose.

Items.Name: flashlight
Items.InitialDescription: Sat neatly on top of the blanket is your handy dandy flashlight.

Items.Name: backpack
Items.Description: Increases how many things you can carry.
Items.InitialDescription: Shoved in the far corner of the trunk sits your high school backpack. That shit can hold the world without breaking.

Items.Name: waterbottle
Items.InitialDescription: A water bottle for your troubles.

Items.Name: jacket
Items.InitialDescription: A dusty denim jacket rests on one of the rocks.

Items.Name: newspapers
Items.InitialDescription: There's a few newspapers scatters around your feet. They speak about sighting of a creature in the nearby forest

Items.Name: paper
Items.Description: Small piece of a paper from the church pew.
Items.InitialDescription: In one of the pews. there is a small piece of paper. THere is a flower drawn in the corner.

Items.Name: pen
Items.Description: A bic pen from the church pew.
Items.InitialDescription: Along with the paper is a pen. It's almost out of ink.

Items.Name: Bibles
Items.InitialDescription: On the alter sits a stack of Bibles. The top one is open to Revelation.

Items.Name: chalice
Items.InitialDescription: A gold chalice stands next to the stack of Bibles.

Items.Name: candle
Items.InitialDescription: A single white candle is positioned in the center of the alter. It is the only thing illuminating the church, melted wax is dripping down the side.

Items.Name: key
Items.Description: It's a key, with a horse on it. That's it.
Items.InitialDescription: A key with a horse engraved on it rests on the small table next to a newspaper like the ones in the gas station.

Items.Name: bread
Items.InitialDescription: A loaf of mold bread sits on the counter. It looks damp inside the bag.

Items.Name: mug
Items.InitialDescription: A single ceramic mug sits on a shelf in one of the cabinets. It has a capybara printed oon it with the text "I LOVE MY CAT" written in bold letters.

Items.Name: spoon
Items.InitialDescription: A small silver spoon sits in the sink. It's covered in a mysterious brown goo and is stuck to the sink.

Items.Name: vase
Items.InitialDescription: There is a small vase on the table nearby. It is light blue with a lace pattern painted on it.

Items.Name: flowers
Items.InitialDescription: A small bouquet of flowers sits in teh vase ont he table. they seem to have been there for a while.

Items.Name: bottle
Items.InitialDescription: A small empty pill bottle rests on the edge of the sink.

Items.Name: journal
Items.InitialDescription:
A journal rests on the edge of the bed. In it are many pages of someone writing about experiences with a creature in the forest. Compared to the articles in the newspapers, it described the creature as one who is simply observant rather than malicious.You wonder if that is true.
 You suddenly feel as if eyes are on you.

Items.Name: meat
Items.Description: It is rotting, why did you take this. Freak.
Items.InitialDescription: On one of the tables sits an empty glass an a plate with a rotting piece of meat. Flies swarm around the table.
There is a $20 dollar bill.

Items.Name: generator
Items.InitialDescription: A solar powered generator sits inside. Now you just have to wait till day to charge your phone, call a tow truck and leave this place!

Items.Name: scroll
Items.Description: A piece of paper with the code 05-22-25 falls, it looks like a code!
Items.InitialDescription: A piece of paper with the code 05-22-25 falls, it looks like a code!
